scope: Standing Bardo National Museum exterior in Tunis: historic beylical palace, its garden arcade and the attached modern museum wing.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Tunisian National Heritage Institute records a portico added to the simple historic facade in 1968 and the distinct entry through the new wing.
The national heritage agency identifies the protected historic palace and the modern wing from 2009–2012 with a new public entrance hall.
The architectural project describes its monumental main entrance, passages, patios and skylights.
The funding institution records rehabilitation, addition and the May 2012 reopening.
